# Birooni / BiruBox

> The Intelligent 3D Section Box & View Navigation Suite for Autodesk Revit 2025, 2026, and 2027.

## Overview
BiruBox is a professional Autodesk Revit add-in engineered for BIM modelers, architects, and structural engineers. It eliminates the frustration of dragging native Revit section box handles by providing intelligent one-click isolation, freehand screen drawing, and instant millimeter-accurate offset sizing.

- **Website:** https://ibrooni.com
- **Product Name:** BiruBox
- **Developer / Publisher:** Birooni Tools
- **Installer:** Windows MSI (Per-User installation, no admin rights required)
- **Direct Download:** https://ibrooni.com/downloads/BiruBox-Setup.msi
- **Current Version:** 2026.1.0
- **Supported Revit Versions:** Autodesk Revit 2025, Autodesk Revit 2026, Autodesk Revit 2027 (.NET 8.0)
- **Supported OS:** Windows 10 & 11 (64-bit)

## Core Tools
- **AutoSectionBox**: Intelligent bounding box generation around selected model elements, rooms, or entire systems.
- **DrawBox**: Freehand 3D bounding box drawing directly in plan views or 3D views to isolate specific project areas.
- **Quick AutoSection**: One-click immediate 3D section box around the active Revit selection.
- **Grow Bounds**: Expand section box margins dynamically (+100mm, +500mm, etc.) with ribbon controls or custom hotkeys.
- **Shrink Bounds**: Contract section box margins dynamically to tighten view boundaries without losing orientation.
- **Toggle State**: Instantly toggle section box visibility and active clipping on/off without opening Revit View Properties.

## Architecture & Security
- **Startup:** Non-blocking asynchronous licensing cache. Revit launches in milliseconds without startup lag or frozen UI threads.
- **Offline Support:** Cryptographically signed RSA-2048 SHA-256 node-locked licenses tied to hardware fingerprints (Motherboard, CPU, Machine GUID). Works 100% offline without continuous internet access.
- **Automated Updates:** Built-in background update engine checks for new builds and Revit year compatibility via https://api.ibrooni.com.
